  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:3900550949",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "plumbing logger instances through kernel objects makes the logging interface cumbersome and easy to misuse if forgetting to log to context cannot be enforced",
      "quote": "logging interface becomes more cumbersome, i.e. caller has to figure out if a logger is in scope and if it should be used. It is easy to misuse (e.g. forget to log to context when it exists, which seems hard to enforce.)",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "stickies-v accepted the author's suggested per-file compile-time enforcement approach",
      "author_replies": ["c:4012471740"],
      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "c:4018435280",
      "status_by_quote": "Nice, I hadn't thought of a per-file approach, that seems elegant."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:3900550949",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "defer contextualized logging until there is clear demand and use cases from users, rather than incurring large review cost and merge conflicts",
      "quote": "non-trivial code change / review cost, lots of merge conflicts... I think this change might become more desirable if/when we have more demand for this feature",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "author asked what was difficult to review; stickies-v pushed back, reiterating that users do not need contextualized logging and favoring simpler global logging (#34775)",
      "author_replies": ["c:4012471740"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:4018435280",
      "status_by_quote": "I just don't think it's currently important as it seems users (incl myself) don't actually need this. Just making kernel logging explicitly global... seems like the more pragmatic change to me now."
    }
  ],
  "support": [

}
